agency.title: Sponsorship opportunities
agency.description: Show brands a moment from a roster creator (a race, a show, a live stream) for one of them to sponsor.
agency.emptyHint: Pick the creator, the date and what the brand gets. Brands are notified right away.
agency.unavailableHint: Try again in a few minutes.
agency.audienceSelected: {count, plural, one {For # chosen brand} other {For # chosen brands}}
agency.newHint: Shows on the agency's, the creator's and the chosen brands' calendars. Brands see each tier's asking price.
agency.brandsHint: Each brand only sees its own reply.

form.talentHint: Only roster creators with valid consent.
form.talentLocked: There are replies already: the creator can't change.
form.noTalents: No creator with valid consent in the roster.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: Rio Marathon with live stream
form.titleRequired: Use a title with at least 3 letters.
form.locationPlaceholder: E.g.: Rio de Janeiro, Flamengo Park
form.descriptionHint: What will happen. Brands read this text.
form.perksPlaceholder:
Logo on the shirt
3 live stories
form.perksInvalid: Each item needs 3 to 120 characters, no repeats, up to {max} items.
form.respondHint: Up to the end of the event.
form.noValues: No amounts: the commercial proposal follows in the campaign of whoever wants to sponsor.

tiers.title: Sponsorship tiers
tiers.hintAdmin: 1 to 3 tiers (e.g. Main, Support). The asking price is what the creator needs; without it, brands see “Price to be agreed”.
tiers.hintManager: 1 to 3 tiers (e.g. Main, Support). The asking price is set by the agency Admin.
tiers.name: Tier name
tiers.locked: Tier with proposals can't be removed

errors.name: Tier {n}: name with 2 to 40 characters.
errors.nameRepeated: Tier {n}: another tier has this name.
errors.perks: Tier {n}: each item 3 to 120 characters, no repeats, up to {max}.

form.publicHint: Same fields as the campaign. Brands see it and the campaign starts pre-filled.
form.valuesAdmin: Brands in the audience see each tier's asking price, never other brands' proposals.
form.valuesManager: The asking price is filled in by the agency Admin.

decide.title: Decision
decide.hint: Pick the brand (or brands) that will sponsor. The others that replied are told it was closed.
decide.confirmClose: Brands that replied are notified and their drafts are cancelled.
decide.confirmCancel: It leaves the calendar, brands that replied are notified and their drafts are cancelled.

done.sponsor: Sponsorship confirmed. Brands and creator notified.

decide.agreedLocked: Brands with a deal are always sponsors.

agency.tierNoPrice: No asking price — brands see “Price to be agreed”
agency.tierPriceSet: Asking price set by the Admin
agency.tierNoPriceManager: No price yet: the Admin fills it in
agency.proposalsHintAdmin: Each brand sees only its own negotiation. Accept, decline or counter.
agency.proposalsHintManager: You follow status and deliverables; prices and replies are up to the Admin.
agency.awaitingAgency: {count, plural, one {# proposal to answer} other {# proposals to answer}}

brand.title: Sponsorship opportunities
brand.description: Moments from {agency} creators your brand can sponsor.
brand.descriptionNoAgency: Moments from creators your brand can sponsor.
brand.emptyHint: When the agency offers a moment to sponsor, it shows up here and in the bell.
brand.unavailableHint: Try again in a few minutes.
brand.respondHint: Not interested? Let the agency know by {date}.
brand.messageHint: E.g.: we want the logo on the chest.
brand.interestSent: Interest sent. The campaign is a draft: review it and send it for approval.
brand.changeToInterest: Changed your mind? You can still sponsor.
brand.readOnly: Only brand team members can reply.
brand.expiredHint: The deadline to reply has passed.
brand.wonHint: The agency chose your brand. Continue in the campaign.
brand.noValues: Amounts are agreed with the agency in the campaign.
brand.fromSponsorship: This campaign came from the sponsorship opportunity “{title}” with {name}.

talent.title: Sponsorship opportunities
talent.hint: Your moments the agency offered to brands.

action.accept_asked: Accepted the tier at the asking price

composer.amountHintNoAsk: The agency set no price: propose yours.
composer.extraPlaceholder: Ask for more: e.g. feed post
composer.notePlaceholder: E.g. we close if the logo is on the chest
composer.audienceToggle: Tell the audience I'm interested in
composer.perksInvalid: Keep at least one item (3 to 120 characters, no repeats, up to {max}).

negotiation.agreedHint: Amount and deliverables are frozen. The campaign is ready with them: review and send.

endReason.tier_full: The tier was closed with another brand.
endReason.returned: The owner returned this proposal before sending.

negotiation.ownerReviewHint: {name} prepared this round. Approving sends it to the agency.
negotiation.waitingOwner: Waiting for the brand owner to approve.
negotiation.waitingAgency: Sent. Now it's the agency's turn.
negotiation.tiersHint: The price is what the agency asks. Accept it or make your own offer.
negotiation.cannotPropose: Offers are closed now (deadline passed or opportunity closed).
negotiation.readOnly: Only the brand team can negotiate.
negotiation.staffHint: What you send goes to the brand owner for approval first.

acceptAsked.title: Accept at asking price?
acceptAsked.body: {tier} tier for {amount}. The sponsorship is agreed right away and the campaign is created.
acceptAsked.bodyStaff: {tier} tier for {amount}. It goes to the brand owner for approval.

accept.title: Accept the counteroffer?
accept.body: Closes at {amount} with the agency's deliverables.
accept.bodyStaff: {amount}. It goes to the brand owner for approval.

decline.title: Decline the negotiation?
decline.body: The agency is notified. While the opportunity is open you can make another offer.

return.title: Return to the team?
return.body: Nothing goes to the agency. Say what to adjust.

agency_accept.title: Accept the offer?
agency_accept.body: {brand} sponsors for {amount}. Amount and deliverables are frozen.

agency_decline.title: Decline the offer?
agency_decline.body: The brand is notified with your note.

negotiation.valuesAdminOnly: Prices: only the agency Admin sees them.
negotiation.agencyAgreedHint: The brand's campaign was created with the agreed amount and deliverables.
negotiation.adminAnswers: Waiting for the agency Admin to reply.
negotiation.agencyPrivacy: Each brand sees only its own negotiation; the creator sees only what was agreed, without prices.

done.agreed: Sponsorship agreed. The campaign is ready.
done.toOwner: Sent to the brand owner for approval.
